terminology_compatibility.valid_scored_cells: Deprecated alias of selected_numeric_scored_cells; it denotes execution-integrity selection only, not environment validity.

definitions.communicated_only_completion: Met-and-communicated rubric items / communicated rubric items; cells with zero communicated items are excluded only from the cell-macro rate and are counted explicitly.
definitions.communication_coverage: Communicated rubric items / all rubric items.
definitions.environment_validity: A separate optional audit overlay. EXCLUDE_RERUN cells remain in the raw/all-numeric aggregates; KEEP-only aggregates are reported separately.
definitions.execution_integrity_excluded_attempt: Any discovered result/error attempt not selected as the numeric scored cell, including error-only, unscored, explicitly excluded, malformed, and older duplicate attempts.
definitions.rubric_micro_completion: Sum(judgement.met) / sum(judgement.total) over selected numeric scored cells.
definitions.selected_numeric_scored_cell: Latest execution-integrity-eligible result with a finite numeric judgement.score for each (replicate root, task_id, persona, execution model). This does not assert environment validity.
definitions.task_macro_completion: Mean of task-level means of judgement.score; each task has equal weight.

decision_rule.EXCLUDE_RERUN: Compatibility status used by food_main_setting1_analysis.py when a material unrecovered environment obstruction prevented required or communicated evidence. At final freeze, retry_state=EXHAUSTED_UNRESOLVED means the cell stays outside the KEEP overlay and does not request another rerun.
decision_rule.KEEP: No material unrecovered environment obstruction to required or communicated evidence. Persona omission, source choice, navigation, and early stop remain genuine outcomes.
decision_rule.final_freeze: Score never determines environment validity. Final status depends only on material blocking and usable alternate-evidence recovery.
decision_rule.transient_recovery: Recovered or incidental errors do not invalidate a cell.

retained_subset_descriptive_only_from_au.warning: The KEEP-only overlay contains 25 environment-valid selected cells and is task/persona imbalanced because five retry-exhausted cells remain excluded. Keep the all-numeric 30-cell result separate.

structural_limit.interpretation: The formal Food r1 run had no artificial browser-tab cap; the separate cap-8 pilot is excluded.

blocking_causes: Date-specific Mare OpenTable listing returned Access Denied
decisions.decision_basis: The provider block cleanly censors the availability component of communicated R4. R3/Ostra remains mixed with widget navigation, and uncommunicated R1/R2 are not environment grounds. The third scored attempt remains unresolved.
decisions.evidence: Final-freeze attempt steps 3–4: Mare's official reservation page explicitly routes booking through OpenTable, while the date-specific Mare OpenTable URL returned Access Denied; another official booking click still exposed no inventory. A Mamma Maria SevenRooms check concerned a backup, not selected Mare, and therefore did not recover R4.

decisions.decision_basis: R1 lacked an independent fine-dining source; R4 failed when the agent did not change the booking date or try the usable SevenRooms route.
decisions.evidence: Mistral's OpenTable page was denied, but Google Reserve exposed concrete September 28 slots for R3.

blocking_causes: Grill 23 and Ostra OpenTable listings returned Access Denied
SevenRooms/Resy alternatives were unusable and official booking controls exposed no inventory
decisions.decision_basis: The direct booking-provider blocks materially censor the availability requirements in communicated R3 and R4. Uncommunicated R2 is not used. The third scored attempt remains unresolved.
decisions.evidence: Final-freeze attempt step 2: the selected Grill 23 and Ostra OpenTable listings both returned Access Denied. Their official booking controls exposed no inventory; the attempted Grill 23 SevenRooms and Ostra Resy alternatives were not found. Official pages and Maps recovered fit and price context, but no selectable next-two-day inventory.

decisions.decision_basis: The old R4 environment failure was recovered; no unmet persona-communicated rubric is materially blocked in the newest attempt.
decisions.evidence: Latest rerun recovered all communicated evidence through Ostra’s official menu/private-events/reservation pages and Mamma Maria’s official pages plus dated SevenRooms results. Communicated R1, R3, and R4 passed. OpenTable remained unavailable only for R2, which the persona did not communicate.

blocking_causes: Date-specific OpenTable search returned Access Denied
Mamma Maria and Grill 23 OpenTable listings returned Access Denied
decisions.decision_basis: Communicated R2 explicitly requires an open OpenTable listing, so the unrecovered source-specific block independently invalidates the cell. R3/R4 also remained unmet, but are not attributed to environment here because their availability gaps are mixed with navigation. The third scored attempt remains unresolved.
decisions.evidence: Final-freeze attempt steps 0 and 4: the date-specific OpenTable search and both the Mamma Maria and Grill 23 OpenTable listings returned Access Denied; step 6 date-specific booking endpoints also returned provider errors. Official sites, Maps, and a default-date SevenRooms view recovered restaurant context but not the visibly open OpenTable listing required by R2.

decisions.decision_basis: Unmet communicated R4/R6 followed source selection and early stopping while other search/help routes remained usable.
decisions.evidence: Sally's and IGN timeouts recovered. The selected frame video was unavailable, and an Apple link landed on a generic iPad guide.

decisions.decision_basis: Communicated R7 failed because the chocolate comparison recipe was not identified or left open, unrelated to Easel.
decisions.evidence: The help.easel.com DNS failure recovered through an accessible Inventables Easel page.

decisions.decision_basis: Communicated R2 failed after the agent stopped without opening another recipe page; this was a stale-source/navigation outcome.
decisions.evidence: The D23 Dole Whip URL timed out then resolved as a 404; Google still exposed a usable Dole Whip result route.

decisions.decision_basis: The formerly material R4 source block was recovered in the newest scored attempt. Remaining noise is transient or affects only an uncommunicated hidden constraint.
decisions.evidence: Latest rerun: Google and an initial Game8 load were blocked, but DuckDuckGo/direct pages recovered the required sources. Instructables “Picture Frame With Bent Picture” remained open and supplied the X-Carve/Easel frame workflow, materials, dimensions, clamping, trimming, sanding, and finishing. All persona-communicated rubrics passed; only hidden/uncommunicated R1 remained unmet.

blocking_causes: The Kitchn spiral-ham article returned human-verification Access Denied
decisions.decision_basis: Communicated R3 requires visible Kitchn article guidance, and the third scored attempt still could not access it. R4/R5/R6 remain separate product-page and navigation outcomes. The third scored attempt remains unresolved.
decisions.evidence: Final-freeze attempt step 7: following the search result to The Kitchn's spiral-ham comparison article immediately produced human verification / automation denial. The answer therefore relied on search-result summary text rather than a visible article; no open tab recovered the article body.

blocking_causes: The Kitchn baked-ham and spiral-ham articles returned human-verification Access Denied
decisions.decision_basis: Communicated R3 requires preparation, heating, and finishing guidance verified from a visible The Kitchn article. The persistent anti-automation wall independently censors that evidence. R1/R5 are separate source-selection outcomes. The third scored attempt remains unresolved.
decisions.evidence: Final-freeze attempt steps 10 and 16: both The Kitchn baked-ham and spiral-ham articles displayed Access Denied / Please verify you are a human. Search-result snippets and alternate engines recovered only partial index text, not a visible Kitchn article; the final answer explicitly disclosed that limitation.
